nodes.name: healing.ts
nodes.summary: Single source of truth for extracting heals that powers store in their damage field as Heal-type entries (Life Drain, Reconstruction, DNA Siphon, ...), splitting the enhanceable portion from the IgnoreStrength-flagged unenhanceable portion; replaces logic previously duplicated in InfoPanel, PowerInfoTooltip, and CompareSlottingModal.

nodes.name: extractHealingFromDamage
nodes.summary: Filters Heal-type entries out of a power's damage array, summing same-table heal scales and tracking the IgnoreStrength portion that healing enhancements must not boost.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-exporting the entire calculations module surface (~140 symbols): damage and ArcanaTime, enhancement bonuses with ED, set bonuses and Rule-of-5 tracking, character totals, AT inherent mechanics (Fury, Scourge, Containment, crits, Domination), perma calculations, buff/debuff modifiers, and exemplar/incarnate level rules.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure re-export barrel with no local definitions; consumers import calc functions from '@/utils/calculations' rather than individual modules.

nodes.name: pet-damage.ts
nodes.summary: Calculates DPS for summoned pets and pseudo-pets using pet class tables with the three-tier Base/Enhanced/Final display, including Mastermind upgrade tiers, resolved pseudo-pet damage with PvP/inherent-table filtering, non-damage effect synthesis, and AoE geometry resolution for proc calculations.

nodes.name: calculateAbilityBaseDamage
nodes.summary: Computes a pet ability's base damage per activation by resolving each damage entry against the pet class table at the given level.

nodes.name: calculateCycleTime
nodes.summary: Computes a pet ability's effective cycle time (cast plus recharge, with a minimum floor) for DPS conversion.

nodes.name: calculatePetDamage
nodes.summary: Main pet DPS entry point: resolves the pet entity, applies Mastermind upgrade tiers, aggregates per-ability base/enhanced/final damage across the entity count and duration, and collects non-damage effects.

nodes.name: calculateResolvedPseudoPetDamage
nodes.summary: Computes damage for a resolved pseudo-pet (e.g. rain patches, debuff entities), filtering PvP and inherent-damage tables, honoring powered-up variants, and producing the three-tier ability breakdown.

nodes.name: shouldApplyEnhancements
nodes.summary: Decides whether slotted enhancements copy to a pet's damage based on the entity's CopyBoosts flag.

nodes.name: synthesizePseudoPetEffects
nodes.summary: Synthesizes a PowerEffects-shaped object from a pseudo-pet summon's entity abilities (enhanceable buffs/debuffs and mez), so pet-delivered effects display like native power effects.

nodes.name: getPseudoPetAoEGeometry
nodes.summary: Derives the dominant AoE radius/arc geometry across a pseudo-pet summon's entity abilities.

nodes.name: resolveProcAreaGeometry
nodes.summary: Resolves the area geometry used for proc chance math, preferring the power's direct radius/arc and falling back to pseudo-pet geometry.

nodes.name: power-at-mechanics.ts
nodes.summary: Single source for archetype hit-time damage mechanics — Scrapper/Stalker/Sentinel crits, Corruptor Scourge, Controller Containment — the multiplicative bonuses applied outside the damage cap; deliberately excludes additive strength buffs like Fury and Vigilance, which are already folded into global damage.
nodes.languageNotes: The multiplier intentionally does not apply to proc damage: the planner keeps proc averages flat even though the game crits procs at hit time.

nodes.name: resolveAtMechanic
nodes.summary: Dispatches on archetype context to compute the applicable hit-time mechanic (Scourge, crit, Assassination, Containment, Opportunity) for a power.

nodes.name: atMechanicMultiplier
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper returning just the damage multiplier from resolveAtMechanic.

nodes.name: chain-expressions.ts
nodes.summary: Humanizers for the two chain-power RPN expressions recovered from powers.bin (chainTargetExpression and maxTargetsExpression), turning raw token lists into short player-readable descriptions for the Info panel.

nodes.name: describeChainTarget
nodes.summary: Describes a ChainTarget expression's next-jump rule by testing for stat-deficit clauses (kHitPoints%, kEndurance%, kAbsorb%) versus pure-proximity chains.

nodes.name: describeTargetCap
nodes.summary: Describes a conditional max-targets expression (stack-scaling caps, Gauntlet target cap) in player terms.

nodes.name: format-precision.ts
nodes.summary: The single rounding primitive for every displayed number in the planner: rounds to a declared max number of decimals then strips trailing zeros, so float noise from scale-times-table arithmetic never leaks into the display.

nodes.name: formatPrecision
nodes.summary: Rounds a value to maxDecimals then strips trailing zeros (3.7500001 becomes '3.75', 45 becomes '45').

nodes.name: mode-suppression.ts
nodes.summary: Pure, dependency-free model of CoH combat-mode suppression: active powers that set modes (Granite_Mode, Kheldian form modes) suspend powers carrying those modes in modesSuspended, dropping their effect contribution while keeping endurance cost and set bonuses; shared by the totals calc and the UI suppression hook.
nodes.languageNotes: A suppressed toggle is still on — only its own effect contribution is dropped, so the set-bonus path is deliberately untouched.

nodes.name: computeModeSuppression
nodes.summary: Given the build's active powers, collects the live modes set by active powers and maps each power whose modesSuspended intersects them to its suppression info.

nodes.name: modeLabel
nodes.summary: Formats a raw mode id (e.g. 'Granite_Mode') into a human-readable label for UI display.
